name: pdfstruct
description: Convert documents and images locally with PDFStruct. Claude gets statuses and file names, not the document content.
long_description:
PDFStruct converts PDF, DOCX, TXT, Markdown, HTML and images on this computer into JSON, HTML, TXT, Markdown, CSV, XLSX, DOCX, JSONL, SQLite and PDF, with OCR when a page needs it.

This extension is a launcher. It starts the active PDFStruct runtime that install-windows.cmd put into your user profile (.local\pdfstruct\current). Install that first. The extension does not bundle PDFStruct, needs no API key and sends nothing to a third-party service.

Workflow: convert returns statuses and output file names only; search and read_excerpt return small, capped pieces of text and only when you ask to read a document.

tools.name: convert
tools.description: Convert local files into one or more formats. Returns status and output file names only.

tools.name: inspect
tools.description: Type, size, page count and likely extraction method of a file. No content.

tools.name: supported_formats
tools.description: Input and output formats and their limits.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find a phrase in a converted document: page numbers and short snippets.

tools.name: read_excerpt
tools.description: Read at most 2000 characters of extracted text from a converted document.
